page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, Hebrew and Syriac words with Latin glosses and scripture references; running head and page number at the top. No margin notes. Catchword (Syriac) at the lower right.

main_text.p: שִׁיטָא שִׁית שָׁיטְשָׁם Ch. Contemptus, Levis, Despectus, Vilis, Syriac. ܣܝܛܐ Et sermo ejus contemptibilis, 2. ad Cor. 10.10.
שׁוּטַיְתָא Chald. Virga, Baculus, Scipio, Judic. 6. 21. 1. Sam. 14. 43.
שׁוּטָא Ch. Idem, Num. 22. 27. in Jon.
שַׁיָּטָא Ch. Natator, Jesa. 25. 11. Guido explicat instrumentum, super quo quis natare discit: Item Remex. Plur. שִׁיטִין Remiges, Ezech. 27. 6.
שׁוֹל Ch. Fundum. Plur. constr. עַל שׁוּלֵי נָפֵן Ad radices vitis, Jerem. 6. 9.
שׁוֹם שֵׁם Ch. Nomen, Idem quod שֵׁם.

שׁוּמָא Ch. Tumor, Levit. 13. 2. in Jon. Macula, Nota, Num. 19. 2. in Jon. Angulus, Levit. 19. 27. in Jon. Plur. Syr. cum Aff. ܣܘܡܘܗܝ Maculis ejus, 1. Pet. 2. 24. Graece τῷ μώλωπι αὐτῆς, vibice, vel vibicibus ejus.
שׂוֹם שִׂים Chal. Ponere, apponere, adhibere, proponere, statuere, constituere. Ithpehal אִתְשִׂים Poni, apponi, constitui.
שׁוֹעַ Ch. Levit, oblevit, induxit, obduxit. Ithpehal אִתְשַׁע Illini, obduci.

שִׁיעָא שִׁיע Ch. Lutum, caementum, intritum, calx, Gen. 11. 3. מְגוּפַּת שִׂיע Operculum calcis, vel juxta alios, Leve, Num. 19. 9. in Jon. & 15. in Onk. & Targ. Hier. Sic & Deuter. 22. in Jon. Item Nervus, cippus, compes, Jobi 13. 27. & 33. 11.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are given as best read from the scan; the Syriac and Hebrew vowel points are only approximate in places. The Syriac lines and the bottom-right catchword are doubtful.
